---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or improvement for FamilyClaw
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Use case

Describe the problem or workflow this feature would support — not just the
solution. Who needs this and why?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like FamilyClaw to do. Sketch the API, config, or behavior if you
have one in mind.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you considered, and why you didn't choose them.

## Scope check

- [ ] This is a generic, public-runtime feature (no private/Layer B content)
- [ ] This does not require breaking an existing public API without a version bump
- [ ] This fits within the reliability invariants (durable replay, at-most-once
      dispatch, fail-closed approval) — or explicitly proposes changing one,
      with justification

## Additional context

Links to related issues, discussions, or prior art in other frameworks.
